handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned PTJ-004 away from unavailable lane Claude2 (disabled, paused, sidecar-only, or auth-down); reviewer Claude2 -> Antigravity.
Helper-claimed by idle Codex; previous owner Codex2 becomes reviewer.
Implementation and owner evidence ready at docs/reviews/2026-07-12-ptj-004-codex-handoff.md; 14 focused BFF tests pass. Please review commit 0f9e105fe plus anchor bb71e321b.

Changes required: governed POST commands only create process-local receipts, accept nonexistent resources, and never surface downstream unavailability. Connect to a durable command/audit owner and add fail-closed tests; see reviewer artifact.

Reviewer blockers addressed at 5dfcd3989: commands now validate target existence and allowed state, fail closed when projection or durable command owner is unavailable, persist fsync-backed JSONL idempotency/audit records, replay across app/router recreation, and no longer claim boolean process-local audit. Verification: focused suite 16 passed; py_compile and git diff --check passed. Please re-review docs/reviews/2026-07-12-ptj-004-codex2-review.md findings.

Changes requested after re-review: 5dfcd3989 persists only BFF admission in JSONL and never delegates retry/submit-review/decide to a durable reflection/governance command owner; accepted/durable audit remains overstated, and process-local locking does not provide multi-worker atomic idempotency. See docs/reviews/2026-07-12-ptj-004-codex2-review.md.
Re-review 28a1cd0ed: durable owner delegation replaces BFF JSONL admission; fail-closed absent/reject/malformed; 17 focused tests cover downstream rejection and concurrent same-key owner admission.

Changes requested on 28a1cd0ed: malformed 2xx JSON arrays and non-JSON HTTPError bodies escape fail-closed translation; validate decoded owner bodies and add both regression tests. See docs/reviews/2026-07-12-ptj-004-codex2-review.md.

Addressed 28a1cd0ed re-review findings in 6ba87c2ca: command-owner responses now require a decoded JSON object for both 2xx and HTTPError paths; malformed 2xx arrays and non-JSON HTTPError bodies fail closed as DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. Focused suite: 19 passed.
Review approved after fail-closed command-owner response regressions passed; returned to Codex for PR finalization and merge.
